title: Memory Captioning Lag
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:photo capture_source=* captured_epoch=* captioned_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((captioned_epoch-captured_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by capture_source
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures captioning lag by capture source for photo captioning.
value: Lag tracking shows which capture source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside photo captioning.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `captioning lag` on `memory:photo` events and aggregate them by `capture_source`.
visualization: Table of capture source with average and worst captioning lag.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how long things take for each capture source so you can see where photo captioning slows down.
